# `#[Refreshes]`

**Description:** Defines the columns that should be re-read from the database after the model is inserted or updated, so values generated by the database (defaults, triggers, generated columns) are available on the model.

**Namespace:** `Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\Refreshes`

**Added in:** Laravel 13.33

## Usage

```php
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\Refreshes;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

// Before:
protected array $refreshes = ['slug', 'version'];
```

```php
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\Refreshes;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

// After:
#[Refreshes(['slug', 'version'])]
class Post extends Model
{
    //
}

$post = Post::create(['title' => 'Hello World']);

$post->slug;    // Value generated by the database
$post->version; // Value set by a database trigger
```

Variadic form is also supported:

```php
#[Refreshes('slug', 'version')]
class Post extends Model
{
    //
}
```

The refresh runs after `save()`, `update()`, `increment()` and `decrement()`, using the write connection. Refreshed columns are excluded when the model is copied with `replicate()`.
